senses.gloss: 2. सृज् (ifc.) letting loose, emitting, discharging, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
producing, creating, begetting (also with gen.), Inscr.; MBh.; Rājat.
सृजति m. (used as, a substantive to denote the root सृज्, ‘to create’), Śiś.
सृजान॑ mfn. let go, poured out, shed, emitted, sent forth, hurled, thrown, RV.
सृजय॑ m. a kind of bird, VS. (Mahīdh.)
सृजया॑ (आ॑), f. = नील-मक्षिका, शुक्ल-सर्प, or नील-महिष, TS. (Sch.)
सृज्य mfn. to be let go or emitted or created, BhP.; Sarvad.
सृजवान m. N. of a son of Dyuti-mat (v.l. सृजावण), VP.
